file_id: Ahmed Din & Ors vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 27 May, 2025

sentences.text:
Ahmed Din & Ors vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 27 May, 2025
 
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh

At Jammu
 Wp(C) No. 1332/2025
 Ahmed Din & Ors ...
 Through: Mr. M Nadeem Bhat, Advocate
 Vs
 Ut of J&K & Ors. .....
Through: Mr. Ravinder Gupta, Aag for R-4

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mohd. Yousuf Wani, Judge
 Order
Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG appears and accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.4.

2. Notice shall go to the respondents 1 to 3 in the main as well as in the interim application,
returnable within four weeks, subject to taking of steps for service within a week's period for filing reply/objections.

3. Heard learned counsel for the applicants/petitioners in respect of his prayer for grant of interim relief and considered his submission.
4.

It is the case of the petitioners that although the acquisition process in respect of the land of the petitioners started in the year 2012, yet the respondent No.3-Collector concerned had to apply all the provisions of the Act of 2013 i.e Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for determination of the just compensation in view of the Section 24 of the Act of 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
He submits that the Final Award in the case was passed on 14.01.2023.
5. List on 29.07.2025.
6.

In the meantime, it is made clear that the receipt of the compensation amount as per the impugned award of 14.01.2023 by the petitioners shall be without prejudice to their rights to be adjudicated in this petition.
